public_rationale: At the May 16, 2023 Senate hearing, Altman supported a new regulatory framework and offered to work with lawmakers [e1]. TIME reported on June 20, 2023 that OpenAI had privately asked EU officials in September 2022 to drop a proposed high-risk classification provision and rely on labeling requirements instead [e2]. This supports the claim under the contract’s inclusion of earlier EU lobbying: the private request preceded the hearing, while its disclosure followed it [e1, e2].
limitations: The documented request concerned the EU AI Act; it does not establish efforts to weaken a U.S. Senate proposal [e2].
The June 2023 reporting date does not establish that the documented lobbying occurred during or after the May 2023 hearing [e1, e2].
The evidence does not establish lobbying intensity, motive, insincerity, or whether OpenAI caused the provision’s removal [e1, e2].

public_payload.normalized_proposition: While publicly asking the Senate to regulate it, OpenAI worked behind the scenes to water down regulations.

statement.excerpt: Translation: But (revealed a few weeks later) behind the scenes we will try hard to water down your regulations.

from_speaker: to the Senate, May 2023: Please regulate us
try hard to water down your regulations
our_interpretation: Read this as a retrospective description of lobbying revealed after the hearing, despite the satirical future tense.
Watering down means seeking narrower coverage, exemptions, or fewer binding obligations than a proposed regulatory text.
Read regulations broadly enough to include the EU AI Act. A claim specifically about a U.S. Senate proposal would require different evidence.
The target includes the earlier lobbying subsequently revealed in June 2023; Marcus supplies no starting date.
Assess documented efforts, not their intensity, success, or sincerity.
criteria.support_condition: The hearing shows public support for regulation, and records show nonpublic efforts to narrow proposed AI regulatory obligations during the episode subsequently reported.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The alleged lobbying records show no effort to narrow obligations, or establish that the reported private proposals instead sought equally strict or stronger coverage.
